# WorkWise Visa - Full Documentation & AI Context (llms-full.txt)

> WorkWise Visa is a government-registered, ethical overseas recruitment agency, visa processing consultancy, and human resources provider specializing in international manpower placement for Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) nations (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain) and European destinations (Poland, Malta, Croatia, Romania).

---

## 1. Company Profile & Core Mission

- **Brand Name:** WorkWise Visa
- **Primary Domain:** https://www.workwisevisa.com
- **Core Specialization:** Cross-border recruitment for skilled, semi-skilled, technical, and blue-collar workforces.
- **Industry Verticals Served:**
  - Civil & Infrastructure Construction (Mega Projects, High-Rise, Bridges, Tunnels, Roads)
  - Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing (MEP) & HVAC Engineering
  - Oil & Gas, Petrochemical Refineries, and Industrial Plant Turnarounds / Shutdowns
  - Hospitality, Culinary Arts, Facility Management & Cleaning Services
  - Logistics, Fleet Delivery, Warehousing, and Supply Chain
  - Healthcare Support, Security, and Automotive Technical Services
- **Compliance & Ethics:** 100% compliant with Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), e-Migrate regulations, Saudi Vision 2030 Qiwa protocols, UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE), Qatar Ministry of Labour (MOL), and Kuwait Public Authority for Manpower (PAM).

---

## 2. Key Service Offerings

### A. International Manpower Sourcing & Deployment
- Technical trade testing, practical screening, and interview drives across accredited centers in South Asia.
- Direct employer-to-candidate matching with transparent compensation structures and Zero-Fee recruitment compliance.
- End-to-end mobilization logistics including airfare, transit assistance, and airport reception.

### B. Gulf Work Visa Stamping & Processing
- **Saudi Arabia:** Qiwa digital contract formulation, Saudi MOFA visa authorization, VFS TasHeel submission, and Iqama processing.
- **United Arab Emirates:** MOHRE quota approvals, electronic entry work permits, GDRFA/ICP stamping, DHA medical fitness, and Emirates ID issuance.
- **Qatar:** Ministry of Interior (MOI) work visa clearance, Qatar Visa Center (QVC) biometrics, contract digital stamping, and Qatar ID (QID) printing.
- **Kuwait:** Public Authority for Manpower (PAM) work visa clearance, Kuwait Society of Engineers (KSE) accreditation, and Kuwait MOFA attestation.
- **Oman & Bahrain:** Royal Oman Police (ROP) and LMRA work permit processing.

### C. Technical Trade Testing & Takamol SVP Guidance
- Comprehensive preparation and test booking for the Saudi **Takamol Skill Verification Program (SVP)** across 23 regulated professions (Electricians, 6G Welders, HVAC Technicians, Pipe Fitters, Carpenters, Plumbers).
- 2-stage assessment support covering theoretical computerized testing (30 MCQs in multilingual audio/text) and practical workshop trials.

### D. Medical Coordination (Wafid / GAMCA)
- Online appointment scheduling via **[wafid.com](https://wafid.com)** for GCC-bound workers.
- Medical fit/unfit advisory covering infectious disease screening (TB chest X-rays, Hepatitis B/C, HIV), blood pressure, vision, and repeat test clearance.

### E. Document Attestation & Police Clearance Certificate (PCC)
- Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) PCC online application and police station field inquiry support.
- Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) Apostille stickers for Hague Convention nations (Europe / Schengen).
- Multi-tier Embassy consular legalization for Non-Apostille Gulf nations (State HRD/Home -> MEA -> Target Embassy -> Destination MOFA).

---

## 3. Destination Country Portfolios

| Country | Primary Visa Types | Key Regulatory Bodies | Minimum Blue-Collar Wage Range |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦** | Work Residence Visa (Iqama) | MHRSD, Qiwa, MOFA, TVTC | 1,200 – 3,500+ SAR + Housing/Food |
| **United Arab Emirates 🇦🇪** | MOHRE 2-Year Employment Visa | MOHRE, GDRFA, ICP | 1,200 – 3,800+ AED + Overtime |
| **Qatar 🇶🇦** | Work Residence Permit (QID) | MOL, MOI, QVC, Medical Commission | 1,000 – 2,800+ QAR + 500 Food/Accom. |
| **Kuwait 🇰🇼** | Article 18 Private Sector Visa | PAM, MOI, KSE | 120 – 280+ KWD + Allowances |
| **Oman 🇴🇲** | Employment Residency Visa | Ministry of Labour, ROP | 120 – 260+ OMR + Overtime |
| **Bahrain 🇧🇭** | LMRA Work Permit | LMRA, NPRA | 120 – 250+ BHD + Overtime |
| **Poland & Europe 🇵🇱** | National Type-D Work Visa (Krajowa) | Voivodeship Labour Office | 3,800 – 6,000+ PLN (~€850 – €1,400) |
